title: splitoon
tagline: imagine giving ai access to your venmo account (real) (they could never)
description:
imagine: you and your friends go out to eat and near the end, the bill comes. your friends all don't want to front the bill and neither do you. why? it's a hassle, you're out 30 bucks until they venmo you back. even worse, you have to keep reminding them to pay you or you might completely forget that you paid for this meal (unwillingly)

and pretend they are on top of things and pay you your share right there and then. venmo will take 3-5 biz days to settle in your bank account as you definitely aren’t paying them 3% to get your funds quicker. screw that.

so let’s leverage crypto and base to ensure you get your share of funds right as you spend it. ex: get paid by your friends before your uber gets here or split your dinner bill before the waiter takes your card. 

we want to empower ai with mpc wallets so that you can enable your favorite ai agent to manage your crypto wallet and send/transfer funds as you need.
how_its_made:
- telegram’s api for the bot/ai agent interface that you interact with
- coinbase cdp (mpc wallet) for the managed/on demand wallet that the agent can access for you
- openai api for responses and image processing
- built off of coinbase’s replit template (telegram trading bot, stripped away most functions for the idea flow)
    - supports uploading a receipt/bill (processed via gpt-4o)
    - sending out a request to counterparty from receipt total
    - approving token transfer to pay out immediately
    - withdrawing/checking balances
